latest_release.name: MediaPipe v1.2.2
latest_release.body:
### Bazel changes

- Fix the tensor shape for column-major matrices in ConvertMatrixToTensorOnCpu.
- Use `'anonymous'` instead of `'Anonymous'` for `HTMLImageElement.crossOrigin`.
- Replace status_macros.h includes with absl/status/status_macros.h in mediapipe/gpu
- Replace status_macros.h includes with absl/status/status_macros.h in mediapipe/tasks/vision and benchmark
- Alias mediapipe::StatusBuilder and mediapipe::source_location to Abseil equivalents
- Migrate mediapipe::StatusBuilder callers to absl::StatusBuilder
- Migrate DRISHTI_CHECK_OK macros to ABSL_CHECK_OK
- Add C++ and C prerequisite fixes for audio and classifier options.
- Migrate statusor.h and StatusOr<T> to absl::StatusOr<T>
- Clarify in the `HandLandmarkerResult` and `GestureRecognizerResult` documentation across C, C++, iOS, Java, Python, and Web that `Left` and `Right` handedness correspond to the subject's hands rather than the viewer's, and that passing a horizontally mirrored image inverts these outputs.
- Migrate canonical_errors.h to absl/status/status.h
- Modernize ret_check.h to use absl::StatusBuilder and absl::SourceLocation
- Bump MediaPipe version to 1.2.1.
- Add support for configuring Qualcomm HTP PD session
- Migrate RETURN_IF_ERROR and ASSIGN_OR_RETURN to ABSL_* in framework
- Migrate RETURN_IF_ERROR and ASSIGN_OR_RETURN to ABSL_* in gpu
- Migrate RETURN_IF_ERROR and ASSIGN_OR_RETURN to ABSL_* in calculators/tensor
- Migrate RETURN_IF_ERROR and ASSIGN_OR_RETURN to ABSL_* in calculators
- Migrate RETURN_IF_ERROR and ASSIGN_OR_RETURN to ABSL_* in tasks
- Migrate RETURN_IF_ERROR and ASSIGN_OR_RETURN to ABSL_* in util, modules, and examples
- Migrate RETURN_IF_ERROR and ASSIGN_OR_RETURN to ABSL_* in tasks/cc/vision and benchmark
- Add MpBaseOptionsFree to C API base_options.
- Attach the model's output quantization to LiteRT inference runner outputs.
- Add `TaskRunnerOptions::memory_manager` to register a shared `MemoryManager` as `kMemoryManagerService` on the task's `CalculatorGraph` before initialization.
- Bump MediaPipe to 1.2.2
- Release LiteRT CPU output views early unless the output is AHWB-backed.
- Update Swift Package Manager files for the 1.2.2 iOS release.

### MediaPipe Tasks update
This section should highlight the changes that are done specifically for any platform and don't propagate to
other platforms.

#### iOS
- Add MPPCommonUtils helpers for C API conversion.
- Add C API options conversion to MPPBaseOptions+Helpers.
- Add C API classification result conversion to MPPClassificationResult+Helpers.
- Add C API embedding conversion to MPPEmbedding+Helpers.
- Add C API embedding result conversion to MPPEmbeddingResult+Helpers.
- Add C API detection conversion to MPPDetection+Helpers.
- Add C API landmark conversion to MPPLandmark+Helpers.

#### Javascript
- Remove non-SIMD WebAssembly builds from the MediaPipe Tasks Web SDK.

#### Python
- Fix Java builder calls and align Python option defaults in MediaPipe.

**Attention:** *See [https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/)
for the primary developer documentation site for MediaPipe.*

![MediaPipe](https://developers.google.com/static/mediapipe/images/home/hero_01_1920.png)

**On-device machine learning for everyone**

Delight your customers with innovative machine learning features. MediaPipe
contains everything that you need to customize and deploy to mobile (Android,
iOS), web, desktop, edge devices, and IoT, effortlessly.

*   [See demos](https://google-ai-edge.github.io/mediapipe-samples-web/#/home)
*   [Learn more](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions)

## Get started

You can get started with MediaPipe Solutions by following the developer guides
for each solution, including:

*   [audio](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/audio/audio_classifier)
*   [decision](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/decision/decision_maker)
*   [genai](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/genai/llm_inference)
*   [retrieval](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/retrieval/semantic_retriever)
*   [text](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/text/text_classifier)
*   [vision](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/object_detector)

If you need help setting up a development environment for use with MediaPipe
Tasks, follow our setup guides for:

*   [Android](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/setup_android)
*   [iOS](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/setup_ios)
*   [Python](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/setup_python)
*   [Web apps](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/setup_web)

## Solutions

MediaPipe Solutions provides a suite of libraries and tools for you to quickly
apply artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) techniques in your
applications. You can plug these solutions into your applications immediately,
customize them to your needs, and use them across multiple development
platforms. MediaPipe Solutions is part of the MediaPipe [open source
project](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe), so you can further
customize the solutions code to meet your application needs.

These libraries and resources provide the core functionality for each MediaPipe
Solution:

*   **MediaPipe Tasks**: Cross-platform APIs and libraries for deploying
    solutions. [Learn
    more](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/tasks).
*   **MediaPipe models**: Pre-trained, ready-to-run models for use with each
    solution.

To customize and evaluate solutions, use **MediaPipe Studio**. It lets you
visualize, test, and benchmark solutions in your browser.
[Learn more](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/stud
